This is approximate continuous output, not exact f_t or a validated binary64/finite-bit sampler. The actual128-output floating cohort had no nonlinear proposals or clipping events and does not validate those laws. The matched full-law lineage won12.1663s versus1.8814s; physical qualification, useful numerical transient accuracy and practical superiority remain unacquired.
